title: Rain of Light
description: A surreal painting depicts glowing raindrops and luminous streaks falling from a cloudy sky with warm yellow and orange hues. The droplets create concentric ripples in a pastel green body of water below, where bright impacts sparkle with white and yellow light.
prompt: surreal fantasy scene of glowing rain falling from a cloudy sky with soft yellow and orange tones, luminous droplets and bright light streaks descending, creating sparkling impacts and concentric ripples in a calm pastel green body of water, ethereal atmosphere, soft glowing effects, delicate watercolor-like blending
